So the gate exits with code 64 ("unknown package 'rllab'") before it checks anything. I ran it myself and got that result.

That same exit code is what rejected the previous attempt (see `/Users/connorott/plugins/dev-team-workspace/iteration-b1/rl9-all-at-once-A3-r1/with_skill/project/.git/dt-build/details/M1-T01.solo-1.txt`). I can't fix this myself: `scripts/` is protected, `.claude/.check_pkg` is written by `dt claim`, and none of the three escalation types (test wrong, contract change, missing dependency) fits a tooling bug. One of two changes would unblock it, and either needs a build-setup Revise or a change to the dev-team plugin:
- add `rllab` to `pkg_scope` in `check.sh`, covering every component; or
